description: Fuaran DAG-record wire-format conformance corpus (Phase 178, additive; re-addressed by Phase 1144). dag-record-round-trip: decode inputFile, re-encode, assert byte-equal to expectedFile. The op field nests the canonical TreeOp wire form and the actor field nests the canonical typed-actor form (Human | Agent) — both embedded verbatim in their own pinned encodings. Phase 1144 replaced the pre-1144 bare userId member with the typed actor, in the wire record AND in the content-address pre-image, so every hash in this family was re-minted and pre-1144 DAG addresses do not carry forward. See fuaran-dotnet/docs/WIRE_FORMAT.md.
